purpose: Test whether a rolling one-outstanding-nonterminal credit preserves V159's early cold-start overlap while preventing whole-DAG speculative reservation and retaining the V161 throughput margin.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.control_seed_stability: E18 and E20 remain effectively unchanged across V159, V160 and V161; the observed throughput-QPR trade-off is localized to E09.
causal_diagnosis.mechanism: V159 can assign multiple nonterminal descendants of one request before their parents complete, reserving capacity along a DAG. V161 is conservative enough to restore throughput but activates only near the end of the horizon. V162 permits rolling one-stage lookahead: at each request snapshot, no more than one assigned incomplete-parent nonterminal function may be outstanding, and at most one new deterministic short-work candidate may consume a free credit.

frozen_thresholds.queue_density_definition: current pending plus runnable tasks divided by node count
frozen_thresholds.remaining_work_definition: sum over unfinished functions of cpu/mean_node_cpu + cold_start_frames/1000 + output_mb/1000

one_outstanding_credit_definition.outstanding_nonterminal_speculation: a function in Request.fn_node that is not in Request.done_fns, is not an immutable terminal function, and has at least one direct parent absent from Request.done_fns
one_outstanding_credit_definition.snapshot_timing: count outstanding speculation once from the immutable request state at the start of each scheduling window
eligible_new_candidate: the function is exposed by the unchanged PreAllSched collector
the function is nonterminal and has at least one unfinished direct parent
request remaining work is at most 5.5
current queue density is strictly below 8.0
the request has a free credit
one_outstanding_credit_definition.deterministic_selection: among eligible new candidates for one request, select maximum existing immutable critical-path rank, then minimum function ID
one_outstanding_credit_definition.per_window_rule: at most the selected candidate consumes the request credit; all other incomplete-parent nonterminal candidates fail closed for that window
one_outstanding_credit_definition.rolling_release: the credit is released naturally when the assigned speculative function no longer has an unfinished direct parent; completion itself is not required
one_outstanding_credit_definition.invariant: after committing a V162 window, each request has at most one assigned unfinished nonterminal function whose direct parents are not all complete

unchanged_frontiers.terminal_pipeline_players: terminal function with all parents assigned, unchanged and not charged to the nonterminal credit

runtime_inputs_forbidden: a fitted time or admission-count threshold

single_mechanism_change_from_v159.nonterminal_short_players: replace unlimited per-request incomplete-parent admission with the preregistered rolling one-outstanding credit
unchanged: queue-density threshold 8.0 and exact V155 scoring router
SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

checks: exact E09, E18 and E20 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
every admitted incomplete-parent nonterminal player satisfies remaining work at most 5.5 and queue density strictly below 8.0
each request begins a window with at most one outstanding incomplete-parent nonterminal assignment and admits no new one while that credit is occupied
when a request credit is free, at most one new incomplete-parent nonterminal is admitted and it matches the maximum-critical-path-rank/minimum-function-ID deterministic choice
the post-dispatch structural invariant is at most one outstanding incomplete-parent nonterminal assignment per request
occupied-credit rejection, same-window extra-candidate rejection, credit release and at least one admitted rolling-credit candidate are observed
congested short-work and over-work players remain rejected
terminal incomplete-parent players remain admitted at every queue density
every scoring route matches the unchanged V155 threshold-8 router and both routes occur
zero performance or aggregate outcome fields are parsed before audit sealing

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V162 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V162 diagnostics, retire V162 and continue mechanism analysis without running the other seventeen
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V162 training plan reusing these three rows
